messages.subject: accuracy settings
parts:
I am currently running my inla model with 

control.inla=list(cmin = 0, int.strategy = "eb"),

Kind regards,
Sylvan

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] accuracy settings
parts:
cmin = 0 is only recommended if you know what you are doing ...
considering control.inla(strategy = "gaussian", control.vb = list(enable = TRUE)) in combination with inla.mode = "compact" is fast and accurate (see https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csda.2023.107692)
